reponse: The old method no longer works. Your Slack-based setup, which set `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` in `.env.local`, is outdated [1][2]. Since PR #447, flags are served by the API, and `FEATURE_FLAGS` is ignored [2]. Instead, start the API and run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2`, then hard-reload the page [3]. You can verify the flag with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3].
